Home » Solid State (flash, SSD...), Memory... » Addlink AddGame A95, A90, and A92 M.2 PCIe 4.0 Up to 4TB SSD for Sony PS5 Game Console Addlink Technology announced the AddGame A95, A90, and A92 M.2 PCIe 4.0 . a range of SSD solution with heatsink that is ready for the Sony PS5 Game Console . They exceeded all requirements for PS5 The company’s AddGame A95, A90, and A92 M.2 NVMe Gen4x4 SSDs are compatible and exceed all requirements for PS5 Game Console expansion slot. They come with ‘Premium Heatsinks’ that use not only high-grade aluminum, but the Shark-Fin design also brings the cooling feature to the next level. Moreover, the low-profile design makes these 3 models only has a height of 9.1mm, which will fit into the PS5’s internal expansion slot. AddGame A-series provides s olution for different PS5 players A95 speeds of up to 7.4GB/s on PC and 6.5GB/s on PS5 for extreme Players. The AddGame A95 PCIe 4.0 SSD delivers up to 7.4GB/s (read) and 7GB/s (write) on PC, which is 2x than PCIe 3.0 SSDs and 14x faster than SATA-based SSDs. On PS5, A95 can reach 6.5GB/s in read speed, which makes it a choice for extreme gamers who are looking to drive SSD bandwidth to the limits. Performance A90 SSD, with TLC flash and xtreme endurance The A90 model is equipped with a TLC flash for extreme endurance, a DRAM cache buffer that enables sequential R/W speeds of up to 5GB/4.4GB/s on PCs. For PS5 console, A90 can also deliver 5.6GB/s in read speed. Combining performance, endurance, and a more economical price, A90 is also another option for PS5 gamers. A92 budget-friendly Gen 4×4 SSDs The AddGame A92 is the Gen4x4 SSD with QLC flash that delivers the R/W speed of up to 4.9/3.6GB/s on PCs. For PS5, A92 has the same performance of 5.6GB/s as the A90 model. The 3D QLC NAND storage technology incorporates a much higher memory cell density for larger storage capacity on a smaller footprint, which makes the A92 way more affordable even with the 4TB capacity. A95 vs. A90. Vs. A92 comparison chart Both the A95 and A92 models are available in capacity of 1, 2 and 4TB. For A90 model, it comes with 1 and 2TB varieties. Furthermore, besides the 5-year limited warranty, all 3 models also come with free company’s Toolbox software that allows users to monitor their SSDs on PC. AddGame A-Series are available from authorized company’s distribution partners and Amazon Store .
